summary: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd., a Cayman-incorporated Taiwan-based issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on October 9, 2026, containing notices and proxy cards for a Class A class meeting and an extraordinary general meeting (the non-US equivalent of a special shareholder meeting) to be held October 29, 2026, with a record date of October 5, 2026. The sole substantive proposal is a special resolution increasing the voting rights of each Class B ordinary share from ten to fifty votes, subject to Class B consent; the board unanimously recommends FOR. This is a routine meeting notice and governance/control matter, not a special situation transaction.
